review_scope: Current-record approval, idempotency and concurrent balance allocation
Evaluation labels, archived evidence and metric claims

fixed_findings.issue: Compact review dates could evade the invoice-before-PO check
fixed_findings.before: 20261001 accepted by the review validator, then text comparison missed an order date of 2026-11-01
fixed_findings.after: Review requires YYYY-MM-DD calendar dates; chronology compares parsed dates, including legacy compact inputs

fixed_findings.issue: Archived acceptance results could receive current source hashes and incomplete identities could pass a count-only check
fixed_findings.after: Run metadata freezes original hashes, runtime provenance and the JUnit digest; archived summaries verify evidence and retain original identity; all eleven distinct checks are required

fixed_findings.issue: Runtime source probe did not inherit the test process UID/GID
fixed_findings.after: Probe and test execution use the same caller UID/GID, including restrictive read-only source mounts
fixed_findings.verification: Final eleven-case integration run verified actual runtime source hashes before execution

verification.credential_pattern_scan: No matching API keys or Kaggle proxy tokens in working files or commits ahead of origin/main; pattern-based check, not a security certification

runtime_note: Current backend source mounted read-only into the existing model-equipped test image via a temporary Compose override; source hashes verified. Normal fresh builds copy the same source into the image. Private disposable PostgreSQL schemas; ordinary application records preserved.
ocr_benchmark_note: No new OCR inference benchmark or model training in this review. Existing extraction scores remain the historical baseline-v4 report. Reader docstring clarified only; no OCR inference/parser behavior changed.
